plainTranslation: Their refusal to be controlled presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, so you may feel challenged to defend or change the way you come across.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their refusal to be controlled presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, so you may feel challenged to defend or change the way you come across.
summaryDeep: Their refusal to be controlled presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, so you may feel challenged to defend or change the way you come across. You may become guarded, defiant, or unusually aware of which parts of yourself feel acceptable to show. The conflict concerns autonomy and presentation, not automatic attraction or sexual chemistry.
